```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

rsetup::get_data("viz_data")

# Calculate frequencies and percentages
race_summary <- dm  |> 
  group_by(RACE)  |> 
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    percentage = n() / nrow(dm) * 100
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(count, " (", round(percentage, 1), "%)"),
    RACE = factor(RACE)  # Ensure proper ordering
  )

# barplot
ggplot(dm, aes(x = RACE, fill = RACE)) +
  geom_bar(
    color = "black",           # Border color
    linewidth = 0.3,            # Border thickness
    width = 0.7                 # Bar width
  ) +
  
  # Add count and percentage labels on bars
  geom_text(
    data = race_summary,
    aes(x = RACE, y = count, label = label),
    vjust = -0.5,               # Position above bars
    size = 3.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Custom colors for races (using ColorBrewer palette)
  scale_fill_brewer(
    palette = "Set2",            # Colorblind-friendly palette
    name = "Race"      # Legend title
  ) +
  
  # Manual color specification
  # scale_fill_manual(
  #   values = c(
  #     "Asian" = "#E69F00",
  #     "Black" = "#56B4E9",
  #     "White" = "#009E73",
  #     "Hispanic" = "#F0E442",
  #     "Other" = "#CC79A7"
  #   )
  # ) +
  
  # Labels 
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1: Distribution of Race",
    subtitle = paste0("Safety Population (N = ", nrow(dm), ")"),
    x = "Race",
    y = "Number of Subjects",
    caption = "Note: Percentages based on non-missing data."
  ) +
  
  # Scale customization
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)),  # Extra space for labels
    breaks = pretty_breaks()
  ) +
  
  # Custom theme
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    # Title formatting
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(b = 5)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11,
      color = "#2C3E50",
      face = "italic",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(b = 15)
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 8,
      color = "#7F8C8D",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    ),
    
    # Axis formatting
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 11,
      face = "bold",
      color = "#2C3E50"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "#2C3E50"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,                  # Angle for long race labels
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1
    ),
    axis.line = element_line(
      color = "#2C3E50",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ),
    
    # Legend formatting
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 9
    ),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "cm"),
    
    # Grid lines (minimal)
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = "#ECF0F1",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    
    # Plot margins
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20, unit = "pt")
  )
```

```{r}


# boxplot
ggplot(data = vs, aes(x = VISIT, y = TEMP)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "#E6F3FF",           # Light blue fill 
    color = "#2C3E50",           # Dark blue-grey border
    outlier.color = "#E74C3C",   # Red outliers for emphasis
    outlier.shape = 1,           # Open circle for outliers 
    outlier.size = 2,
    width = 0.6,                 # Appropriate box width
    alpha = 0.8                   # Slight transparency
  ) +
  
  # Add mean points 
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,                   # Diamond shape for mean
    size = 3,
    color = "#2C3E50",
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  
  # Add reference line for normal body temperature
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 36.5,            # Average body temperature
    linetype = "dashed",  # "solid" "dotted" "dotdash"
    color = "#E74C3C",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "Figure 2: Distribution of Body Temperature by Study Visit",
    subtitle = "Safety Population",
    x = "Study Visit",
    y = "Temperature (°C)",
    caption = paste0(
      "Note: Horizontal dashed line indicates normal body temperature (36.5°C).\n",
      "Diamonds represent mean values. Data presented as median (IQR) with outliers shown."
    )
  ) +
  
  # Scale customization
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(35, 38),           # relevant range
    breaks = seq(35, 38, by = 0.5),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
  ) +
  # custom theme options
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    # Title formatting
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(b = 5)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11,
      color = "#2C3E50",
      face = "italic",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(b = 15)
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 8,
      color = "#7F8C8D",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(t = 15)
    ),
    
    # Axis formatting
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 11,
      face = "bold",
      color = "#2C3E50"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "#2C3E50"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1
    ),
    axis.line = element_line(
      color = "#2C3E50",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ),
    
    # Grid lines 
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = "#ECF0F1",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    # Legend (if needed)
    legend.position = "none",
    
    # Plot margins
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20, unit = "pt")
  )
```

## 1: Core Components of a ggplot

| Component | Code Element | Purpose | Example |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Data** | `data = dm` | Specifies the dataset | `data = dm` |
| **Aesthetics** | `aes()` | Maps variables to visual elements | `aes(x = RACE, fill = RACE)` |
| **Geometry** | `geom_*()` | Defines the plot type | `geom_bar()` |
| **Labels** | `labs()` | Adds titles and axis labels | `labs(title = "...")` |
| **Theme** | `theme_*()` | Controls overall appearance | `theme_classic()` |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 2: Bar Plot Specific Components

| Component | Code | Purpose | Visual Effect |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Bar Geometry** | `geom_bar()` | Creates bars | Bars representing counts |
| **Border Color** | `color = "black"` | Outlines bars | Black border around bars |
| **Border Thickness** | `linewidth = 0.3` | Controls border weight | Thin, professional lines |
| **Bar Width** | `width = 0.7` | Space between bars | 70% width, 30% gap |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 3: Text Annotation Components

| Component | Code | Purpose | Placement |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Data Source** | `data = race_summary` | Uses summarized data | Pre-calculated table |
| **Label Text** | `aes(label = label)` | What to display | "15 (25.4%)" |
| **Vertical Position** | `vjust = -0.5` | Above/below bar | Above the bar |
| **Text Size** | `size = 3.5` | Font size | Readable but not dominant |
| **Text Color** | `color = "black"` | Label color | Matches theme |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 4: Color Customization Options

| Method | Code | Flexibility | Use Case |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Brewer Palette** | `scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")` | Pre-set, colorblind-friendly | Quick, professional colors |
| **Manual Colors** | `scale_fill_manual(values = c(...))` | Full control | Brand colors, specific schemes |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 5: Title and Label Components

| Element | Code | Purpose | Example |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Main Title** | `title = "Figure 1: ..."` | Identifies the figure | "Figure 1: Distribution of Race" |
| **Subtitle** | `subtitle = "Safety Population..."` | Population info | "Safety Population (N = 200)" |
| **X-axis Label** | `x = "Race"` | Horizontal axis | "Race" |
| **Y-axis Label** | `y = "Number of Subjects"` | Vertical axis | "Number of Subjects" |
| **Caption** | `caption = "Note: ..."` | Additional notes | "Percentages based on non-missing data" |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 6: Axis Scale Components

| Component | Code | Purpose | Effect |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Expand Space** | `expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))` | Room for labels | 15% space above bars |
| **Pretty Breaks** | `breaks = pretty_breaks()` | Automatic nice numbers | 0, 50, 100, 150... |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 7: Theme Components - Titles

| Component | Code | Purpose | Visual |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Title Size** | `size = 14` | Main title prominence | Larger text |
| **Title Face** | `face = "bold"` | Emphasis | **Bold text** |
| **Title Position** | `hjust = 0` | Left-aligned | Left justified |
| **Title Margin** | `margin = margin(b = 5)` | Space below title | 5pt gap |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 8: Theme Components - Axis

| Component | Code | Purpose | Visual |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Axis Title** | `axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")` | Label emphasis | **Race** (bold) |
| **Axis Text** | `axis.text = element_text(size = 10)` | Tick labels | Asian, Black, White |
| **Text Angle** | `angle = 45` | Slanted labels | 45° rotation |
| **Horizontal Adjustment** | `hjust = 1` | Right-align slanted text | Aligned right |
| **Axis Line** | `axis.line = element_line(color = "black")` | Visible axes | Black line |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 9: Theme Components - Legend

| Component | Code | Purpose | Visual |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Position** | `legend.position = "right"` | Legend location | Right side |
| **Title Size** | `legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")` | Legend header | **Race** |
| **Text Size** | `legend.text = element_text(size = 9)` | Category labels | Asian, Black |
| **Key Size** | `legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "cm")` | Color box size | 0.8cm square |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 10: Theme Components - Grid and Background

| Component | Code | Purpose | Visual |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Y-axis Grid** | `panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#ECF0F1")` | Horizontal guides | Light gray lines |
| **Grid Width** | `linewidth = 0.3` | Line thickness | Thin, subtle |
| **No X Grid** | `panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()` | Clean vertical | No vertical lines |
| **Plot Margin** | `plot.margin = margin(t=20, r=20, b=20, l=20)` | White space | Breathing room |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 11: Summary - Complete Plot Layers

| Layer           | Code Section                   | Purpose           |
|:----------------|:-------------------------------|:------------------|
| **1. Data**     | `ggplot(data = dm, aes(...))`  | Foundation        |
| **2. Geometry** | `geom_bar()`                   | Build bars        |
| **3. Labels**   | `geom_text()`                  | Add numbers       |
| **4. Colors**   | `scale_fill_*()`               | Apply colors      |
| **5. Titles**   | `labs()`                       | Add text          |
| **6. Scale**    | `scale_y_continuous()`         | Adjust axes       |
| **7. Theme**    | `theme_classic() + theme(...)` | Polish appearance |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 12: Common Parameters Reference

| Element      | Parameter | Values                    | Effect                 |
|:-------------|:----------|:--------------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Size**     | `size`    | 8-16 (text), 2-5 (points) | Larger = more emphasis |
| **Color**    | `color`   | "black", "#2C3E50", "red" | Border/text color      |
| **Fill**     | `fill`    | "lightblue", "#E6F3FF"    | Interior color         |
| **Width**    | `width`   | 0-1                       | Bar thickness          |
| **Angle**    | `angle`   | 0-90                      | Text rotation          |
| **Position** | `vjust`   | -1 to 2                   | Vertical adjustment    |
